fullPassage: Nearly everything has to go through your mouth to get to the rest of you, from food and air to bacteria and viruses. A healthy mouth can help your body get what it needs and prevent it from harm — with adequate space for air to travel to your lungs, and healthy teeth and gums that prevent harmful microorganisms from entering your bloodstream. From the moment you are created, oral health affects every aspect of your life. What happens in the mouth is usually just the tip of the iceberg and a reflection of what is happening in other parts of the body. Poor oral health can be a cause of a disease that affects the entire body. The microorganisms in an unhealthy mouth can enter the bloodstream and travel anywhere in the body, posing serious health risks.

❌ ② the heart of the matter: '문제의 핵심'은 '작은 일부'라는 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ the end of the road: '막다른 길/끝'은 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ the center of attention: '주목의 중심'은 문맥과 무관
det.tip: the tip of the iceberg = 빙산의 일각 (드러난 작은 부분)

questions.passage: Nearly everything has to go through your mouth to get to the rest of you, from food and air to bacteria and viruses. A healthy mouth can help your body get what it needs and prevent it from harm — with adequate space for air to travel to your lungs, and healthy teeth and gums that prevent harmful microorganisms from entering your bloodstream. From the moment you are created, oral health __________. What happens in the mouth is usually just the tip of the iceberg and a reflection of what is happening in other parts of the body. Poor oral health can be a cause of a disease that affects the entire body. The microorganisms in an unhealthy mouth can enter the bloodstream and travel anywhere in the body, posing serious health risks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 구강 건강은 삶의 모든 측면에 영향을 미친다
det.analysis:
❌ ① protects you from all illness: '모든 질병을 막아준다'는 과장이며 원문과 다름
✅ ② affects every aspect of your life: 원문 일치. 태어나는 순간부터 구강 건강이 삶의 모든 측면에 영향 ←정답
❌ ③ depends on your daily diet: '매일의 식단에 달려 있다'는 본문에 없음
❌ ④ changes with the seasons: '계절에 따라 변한다'는 본문에 없음
det.tip: oral health affects every aspect of your life = 구강 건강은 삶의 모든 측면에 영향
